 Series Notes
  The Rockets swept the Suns, 4-0, last season and have won eight straight games over the Suns
 Phoenix's last victory over Houston came on Feb. 29, 2024, a 110-105 win at home
 Key Connections
 + Suns forward Dillon Brooks was a member of the Rockets from 2023-25, appearing in 147 games and averaging 13.4 points
 Suns guard Jalen Green was selected by the Rockets with the second pick in the 2021 NBA Draft. He played four seasons with Houston, playing in 307
 games and averaging 20.1 points, 4.2 rebounds and 3.3 assists
 Rockets forward Kevin Durant spent three seasons with the Suns from 2022-25, playing in 145 games and averaging 26.8 points and 6.3 rebounds
 Suns AC Jesse Mermuys held the same role with the Rockets under Kevin McHale in 2012-13

 Notes
 The Suns improved to 2-5 with a 117-104 win over Orlando on Nov. 5. Phoenix is now 2-2 at Mortgage Matchup Center this season.
 DEVIN BOOKER tallied a game-high 30 points and now has consecutive 30+ point performances for the firs time this season. He posted his sixth career game of 30+ points, 8+ assists and 3+ steals.
 MILES BRIDGES posted his second double-double of the season with 18 points and 13 rebounds. He is the first Suns player since 2023 to tally 18 points, 13 rebounds, 5 assists and 2 steals in a game. He now has 81 points, 36 rebounds, 15 assists and 9 steals in his last four games, the first Suns player to post those numbers in a four-game span since Shawn Marion in 2005-06.
 COLLIN GILLESPIE had three steals and now has 19 on the season, the most by a Suns player through the first seven games of a campaign since Shawn Marion to start the 2007-08 season.
 Phoenix forced a season-best 25 turnovers, leading to 36 points. The Suns ended with 14 steals and six players had multiple.
 Team Leaders by Points Per Game
 25.4 pts Devin Booker 15 | G 17.6 pts Dillon Brooks 3 | GF 17.4 pts Miles Bridges 22 | F See more stats Last Game Recap
 HOENIX - The Suns (2-5) snapped a four-game losing streak with a 117-104 win over Orlando on Nov. 5. Phoenix won the first quarter by seven as Devin Booker put up 12 points and two three-pointers. Booker had another double digit frame in the second quarter and entered halftime with 23 points. Phoenix shot 51.1% from the field and 52.6% from beyond the arc in the opening half as the Suns forced 13 turnovers leading to 17 points. The Suns won the third period by 11 points, with Dillon Brooks (12 points) and Miles Bridges (10 points) each totaling double digit scoring outputs. Phoenix took its largest lead of the game at 30 points in the fourth quarter where the Suns emptied their bench. Orlando did not lead outside of the first quarter, a quick six-point advantage. Booker led all scorers with 30 points, his second consecutive 30+ point outing. Bridges posted his second double-double of the season with 18 points and 13 rebounds to continue a strong four-game stretch. Collin Gillespie recorded 3 steals to get to 19 in the first seven games of the season, the most by a Suns player through the opening seven games of a campaign since Shawn Marion in 2007-08.
